confirmedRemainingWork: 69 indexed paper components still have no Mark Bank cards. Foundation 2024/2025 and Higher 2024 Paper 2 have completed their visual paper/applicable-scheme sweeps and exact task reconciliation. 88 components remain pending full review.

Review evidence is in irish-paper-reviews.json and its linked source-review files.

Expand published task boundaries across older years and reconcile exact Atlas topics and source/scheme regions. Topic Atlas currently has 1200 section/task/route anchors, including 78 exact 2024 Foundation task joins. This is not proof of complete archive coverage. Reconcile every remaining paper and retain established IDs.

All 91 indexed components now have local papers and paired schemes. The three recovered SEC EV-named schemes are integrated through exact year/file language overrides and bundled verified PDFs, covering eight 2010 Higher/Ordinary and 2011 Foundation components. The original shared corpus is untouched. These components still require full task review; evidence is in irish-recovered-schemes.json.

Listening recordings must be verified for each year and level; Foundation uses different recordings. Preserve passages, poems, signs, forms and picture sequences using the existing open/close source reader.
Full visual paper/scheme sweeps, raw selection-directive classification, preservation and zero-open/zero-orphan checks remain required before any completion claim or coverage-baseline change.

nextReadingReview.status: Reading review complete and incorporated into the completed 2024 Higher Paper 2 review.
findings: Both passages are compulsory: 50 marks each. Questions 1–5 divide into (a)=3, (b)(i)=2 and (b)(ii)=2. Retain both pages of the respective passage with every part.
Where two facts share 3 marks, the first correct fact earns 2 and the second 1. This is not a fixed 2/1 split by printed answer position. Keep the two-fact response whole.

Each 6(a) grammar task similarly awards 2 for the first correct grammar item and 1 for the other: retain one 3-mark task, with 0/2/3 placements, rather than inventing fixed independent 2/1 tariffs. A asks future passive (Alt 3) plus comparative adjective (Alt 4); B asks conditional (Alt 2) plus present passive (Alt 5).
A6(b): whole 12 marks, opinion=2 and two supporting own-word points=5+5. No opinion means supporting points cannot be credited. Preserve the 60-word guidance and source-based own-word requirement.

B6(b): two independently marked insights=6+6. Each insight=2 plus own-word explanation and accurate passage example=4. Without a stated/implied insight the example cannot earn marks. Preserve the original full-response 60-word guidance without inventing per-part word limits.
Scheme examples are indicative, not exhaustive answer-route pools. The source word/fact retrieval options are acceptable answers to the same task, not different tasks.
